mapper.select: SELECT q.tenant_code AS tenant_code, e.company_name AS company_name, t.status AS tenant_status, COALESCE(q.ai_daily_limit, 0) AS ai_daily_limit, COALESCE(q.daily_request_limit, 0) AS daily_request_limit, COALESCE(q.enabled, FALSE) AS quota_enabled FROM tenant_quota q LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_code = q.tenant_code AND t.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE q.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY q.ai_daily_limit DESC, q.tenant_code
